3.source: Spirit Ball, Kamehameha, Ki Barrage, Wolf Fang
3.translation: Esfera Espiritual, Kamehameha, Rajada de Ki, Presa de Lobo

4.source: '''Yamcha''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha's House|Yamcha's House]] in the deserts of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. He teaches Ki Infusion, three ki attacks and his Wolf Fang strike. He trains anyone, whatever their alignment.
4.translation: '''Yamcha''' é um [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|mestre]] que vive na [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha's House|Casa do Yamcha]], nos desertos da [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Terra]]. Ele ensina Infusão de Ki, três ataques de ki e seu golpe Presa de Lobo. Ele treina qualquer um, seja qual for a índole.

6.source: Yamcha lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha's House|Yamcha's House]], which generates once per world in a desert. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 2 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha's House#Finding it|Yamcha's House]]).
6.translation: Yamcha vive na [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha's House|Casa do Yamcha]], que é gerada uma vez por mundo em um deserto. Os Assistentes da Corporação Cápsula vendem um mapa até lá no nível de troca 2 (veja [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha's House#Finding it|Casa do Yamcha]]).

8.source:
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Infusion|Ki Infusion]]
* '''Ki attacks:''' Spirit Ball, Kamehameha, Ki Barrage
* '''Strike attack:''' Wolf Fang
8.translation:
* '''Habilidades:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Controle de Ki]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Infusion|Infusão de Ki]]
* '''Ataques de Ki:''' Esfera Espiritual, Kamehameha, Rajada de Ki
* '''Ataque de Golpe:''' Presa de Lobo

9.source: Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.
9.translation: Tudo é pago com pontos de treino, e sua raça precisa permitir cada habilidade. A opção '''Treinar''' dele invoca um Clone de Sombra para treinar.
